newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian cenbank calls for repo bids, rates steady.
newsitem.headline: Austrian cenbank calls for repo bids, rates steady.

text.p: The Austrian National Bank said on Thursday it was calling for bids on two-week securities repurchase agreements at a fixed 3.0 percent and that its policy-making council had left key interest rates unchanged.
Bids have to be in by 0800 GMT on Friday, it said.
Last week the central bank allotted 8.49 billion schillings, or seven percent of bids, also at a rate of 3.0 percent.
Austria's discount rate stands at 2.5 percent, its Lombard emergency borrowing rate at 4.75 percent and its Gomex money market rate at 3.4 percent.
